name: Number of ways to write n as sum of two powerful numbers (A001694).
link: Amiram Eldar, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..10000
Eric Weisstein's World of Mathematics, Powerful Number.
mathematica: With[{m = 120}, pow = Select[Range[m], # == 1 || Min[FactorInteger[#][[;; , 2]]] > 1 &]; BinCounts[Select[Plus @@@ Union[Sort /@ Tuples[pow, {2}]], # <= m &], {1, m, 1}]] (* _Amiram Eldar_, Jan 30 2023 *)
author: _Reinhard Zumkeller_, Jun 23 2003
